name: Temple Emanuel Mah Jongg Open Play
description: Open play at Temple Emanuel on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month; online reservation required for table setup. The event page does not mention American/NMJL; the temple's earlier 'Learn and Play: Mahjong' page (shalomgreensboro.org calendar copy) says players must get the National Mahjongg League card. Needs confirmation on the temple's own page.

name: Marshall Muse Mahjong Nights
description: Monthly (third Tuesday) mahjong night at Marshall Muse Gallery with Downtown Greensboro Inc. Page says 'obtain a National Mahjong League card prior to attending'. Next date after Oct 20 2026 not confirmed.
